events.title: Dentsply International (XRAY) Lags Q1 Earnings Estimates
events.body: Dentsply (XRAY) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -3.95% and +5.12%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Cooper Companies Earnings Preview: What to Expect
events.body: Cooper Companies is gearing up to report its fiscal second-quarter results soon, and analysts are anticipating low-double-digit profit growth.
